'''December 2000 Las Vegas tournament (16 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, NV on 16 December 2000. [[Matt Berta]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1558">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-18-viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00d1558/ viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 18 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-18-viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00d1558/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Berta]]
